failed_run_binding.reason: dev_healthy did not produce exactly nine complete calendar-day score blocks

evidence.finding: The nine-date interval has no source rows on 2020-02-29. Six dates satisfy the already-frozen 1141-score criterion; requiring all nine dates is structurally impossible and does not measure model power.

development_threshold_revision.supersedes: Only the development_requirement sentence in amendment 001 complete_and_qualified_days.
development_threshold_revision.candidate_dates: Every full dataset-native calendar date in [2020-02-21,2020-03-01) is enumerated and reported, including dates with zero scores.
development_threshold_revision.qualification_rule_unchanged: At least 1141 causal scores out of the theoretical 1426.
development_threshold_revision.unqualified_dates: Excluded from the provisional maximum and reported with their score counts and reason.
development_threshold_revision.minimum_rule_rationale: ceil(2/3 * 9 nominal calendar dates), frozen before the repeated run.
development_threshold_revision.provisional_boundary: Maximum two-channel dev_healthy CUSUM daily maximum over every qualified development date.
